landing.meta_title: VasulBook: collect customer dues on WhatsApp
landing.meta_desc: VasulBook helps shops, tuition centres, milk vendors and every business that gives credit get paid faster with WhatsApp reminders and UPI. {trial} months free.
landing.ref_banner: Your friend invited you to VasulBook. Sign up with their code {code} and get {months} months free.
landing.h1: Get your money back from customers, without the awkward calls.
landing.lede: VasulBook keeps your udhaar book, sends polite WhatsApp reminders with your UPI ID, and shows every evening who paid and who still owes. For shops, tuition centres, milk vendors, tailors and every business that gives credit.
landing.then_price: Then {price} for {months} months. Works on any phone. Install it like an app.
landing.ios_hint: On iPhone: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
landing.mock_msg: Hello Ravi, your balance of ₹1,560 at Sri Lakshmi Stores is overdue by 2 days. You can pay with any UPI app to lakshmi@okaxis. Thank you.
landing.who_title: Made for every business that gives credit
landing.s1_p: Type {code} and it's saved with a due date. Add customers with their WhatsApp number.
landing.s2_t: Send a reminder in one tap
landing.s2_p: A polite WhatsApp message in your customer's language, with your UPI ID or a pay-now link. It gets firmer as days pass.
landing.s3_p: Record payments in a tap, or let Razorpay mark them for you. Every evening you get a summary of what came in.
landing.feat_title: Everything you need to collect faster
landing.f1_p: Credit, payments, due dates and a running balance for each customer, like your paper book but never lost.
landing.f2_p: Ready-made messages in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati and Punjabi, with your shop name and UPI ID.
landing.f3_p: See who is overdue, who is due soon, and who often pays late, before you give more credit.
landing.f4_p: Collected today, new credit and total pending, on your phone and by email at 9 pm.
landing.f5_p: Install it on your phone's home screen. Your ledger opens even without internet.
landing.f6_p: Your customers' details are never sold or shared. Only you can see your ledger.
landing.demo_sub: A one-minute look at adding dues, sending a WhatsApp reminder and recording a payment.
landing.demo_cap: VasulBook demo on a phone (no sound)
landing.p_trial_p: Every feature, no card needed. Cancel anytime by simply not paying.
landing.p_per: That's about {pm} a month. Pay once by UPI, card, net banking or wallet through Razorpay.
landing.p_refer_p: For every business owner who joins with your link. They get an extra free month too.
landing.q1: Do my customers need to install anything?
landing.a1: No. They get a normal WhatsApp message and pay with any UPI app they already use.
landing.q2: Does it work in my language?
landing.a2: Yes. The app and the reminders work in English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati and Punjabi. You can also edit any message before sending.
landing.q3: What happens after the free trial?
landing.a3: You can keep using VasulBook for {price} for {months} months. If you don't pay, your data stays safe and you can still see it; adding entries pauses until you subscribe.
landing.a4: Your ledger is stored securely and only you can see it. We never sell or share your customers' details.
landing.q5: Can I use it on my phone and computer?
landing.a5: Yes. Log in on any device. On your phone, install it to the home screen and it opens like an app.
landing.foot_tag: Collect customer dues faster with WhatsApp reminders and UPI.
